units.title: Introduction to Control Systems
topics: 1.1. Need for control system
1.2. Open-loop, Closed-loop,
1.3. Open loop and closed loop control systems.
1.4. Significance of feedback,
1.5. Effect of feedback on System gain, stability, Noise and sensitivity.
1.6. Servomechanism: DC Closed loop control system. AC Closed loop control system.
1.7. Block diagram of a control system
1.8. Block diagram reduction techniques.
uos: 1.a. Describe the significance of control system in engineering.
1.b. Differentiate between Open and closed loop control system.
1.c. Describe feedback closed loop system and its effects.
1.d. Describe the need for servomechanism with examples
1.e. Describe the working of Automatic Tank level control system and Position control system
1.f. Describe the various control system using block diagram
1.g. Apply block diagram reduction techniques.

units.title: Laplace Transform and Transfer Function
topics: 2.1. Transformation from time domain function to S- domain function and vice versa.
2.2. Basic Laplace transform theorem
2.3. Transfer Function:
2.4. Poles and zeros of Transfer function and its relationship with impulse response
2.5. Transfer function of open and Closed loop control system.
2.6. Transfer function of electrical networks: R-L, R- C, L-C and R-L-C networks.
uos: 2.a. Explain the significance of Laplace transform in control system.
2.b. Use Laplace transforms to find transfer function of control system.
2.c. Define transfer function in terms of poles and zeros.
2.d. Find the transfer function of open loop and closed loop control system.
2.e. Find out transfer function of electrical networks.

units.title: Time Response Analysis of Control System
topics: 3.1. Input test signals: Step, Ramp, Parabolic and Impulse signal.
3.2. Type and order of control system .

3.3. Time response of a first order control system. Unit-impulse, Unit-Step and Unit-Ramp Response. Control System for Power Electronics Course code: 3352405 GTU/NITTTR/Bhopal/14-15 Gujarat State 3 Unit Major Learning Outcomes (Major outcomes in cognitive domain) Topics and Sub-topics
3.4. Time response analysis of a second order control system subjected to unit-step input.
3.5. Critical, under damped, undamped and over damped system.
3.6. Rise time, Peak time, Peak overshoot, Settling time and Steady state error and their significance.
3.7. Response of Proportional (P), Derivative (D), Integral (I) and Proportional plus integral plus derivative control (PID) controller.
3.8. Effect of varying Kd, Ki and Kp on the performance of control system.
uos: 3.a. State the features of Step, Ramp, Parabolic and Impulse signal
3.b. Distinguish between type and order of control system with examples.
3.c. Describe Time response of first order control system using Unit- impulse, Unit-Step and Unit- Ramp Response with sketches.
3.d. Describe Time response of first order control system using Unit- Step with sketches.
3.e. Differentiate between critical, under damped, undamped and over damped control systems
3.f. Distinguish Rise time, Peak time, Peak overshoot, Settling time and Steady state error of a control system
3.g. Explain working of various control system controllers.
3.h. Explain the effect of Kd, Ki and Kp on the performance of control system.

topics: 5.1. Stability, Relative and absolute stability, Need of stability in control system.

5.3. Routh-Hurwitz criterion: Absolute stability, Relative stability.

5.b. Apply Routh – Hurwitz criterion to find out absolute stability and Relative stability.
